standard: NIST SP 800-38D over FIPS 197 (AES-256, 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag)
source_type: independent oracle: pyca/cryptography 46.0.7 (OpenSSL backend) generates, Go crypto/cipher cross-checks; the file is vendored only when both agree byte for byte
notes: Lengths cross the 16-byte block, 64-byte CTR batch and 128-byte GHASH batch boundaries, with AAD absent and long. Invalid cases carry an empty msg; a correct implementation must reject them. Written after the metamui-aes-256 eight-block GHASH defect (missing H^8 factor).
